_what_this_is: The recorded judgement on each credential-shaped hit tools/secret-scan.mjs finds in THIS repo. No record means UNTRIAGED, which the scanner treats as blocking.
_all_one_class: Every hit is an English word beginning 'iter' — iterates, iteration, iterations, iterator — matched by the named-secret-literal detector because it looks for a random-ish literal near a key-ish name.
_rule: A value that is a dictionary word in ordinary prose or code is not a credential. These have no entropy and authenticate nothing.
_note: Recorded as a class rather than one entry per fingerprint would be a shrug; each fingerprint below carries the same named rule, which a stranger can check against the files.
